lessons.title: 把: handle things!
lessons.learn: 把 GRABS objects! 把书放在桌子上 = Take the book, put it on the table. 把门关上 (close the door!), 把茶喝了 (drink up the tea!). Object JUMPS before the verb — with a result attached!

grammar.title: 把 + object + verb + result
grammar.explain: 把门关上 (close the door), 把作业写完 (finish homework), 把茶喝了 (drink the tea up). Verb needs a RESULT: 上/完/了/给…!

examples.en: Put the book on the table.

examples.r: bǎ mén guān shang!
bǎ chá hē le.

mistakes: Saying 把书放 — verbs need RESULTS: 放在…上!

lessons.title: 被: passive + 是…的
lessons.learn: Bad things HAPPEN with 被! 我的杯子被打破了 (my cup got broken). 是…的 stresses HOW/WHEN: 我是昨天来的 (it was YESTERDAY I came). Passive pain + emphasis power!

grammar.title: 被 + doer + verb · 是…的
grammar.explain: 杯子被打破了 (cup got broken), 我被雨淋了 (I got rained on). 是…的: 我是坐车来的 (I came BY CAR — stress!).
grammar.pattern: X 被 (doer) verb了 · 是 + detail + 的

wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de.

mistakes: Saying 被 for happy things — 被 loves BAD news!
Forgetting 的: 是…的 needs BOTH!

lessons.title: Describe a family routine
lessons.learn: Describe a routine and compare it with a past habit.

grammar.title: past experience with 过
grammar.explain: Use 过 to describe an experience or former habit, then contrast it with the current routine.

examples.t: 以前我们周末常常一起做饭。
examples.r: yǐ qián wǒ men zhōu mò cháng cháng yì qǐ zuò fàn。
examples.en: We often cooked together on weekends before.

examples.t: 后来大家的时间不一样了。
examples.r: hòu lái dà jiā de shí jiān bù yí yàng le。

examples.t: 现在我们每个月见一次。
examples.r: xiàn zài wǒ men měi gè yuè jiàn yí cì。
examples.en: Now we meet once a month.

mistakes.wrong: 以前我每周末去过公园。
mistakes.right: 以前我每周末都去公园。
mistakes.why: Use a habitual marker such as 都; 过 is not needed for a repeated routine.

lessons.title: Family: 家
lessons.learn: Family! 爸爸 (dad), 妈妈 (mum), 哥哥 (older brother), 姐姐 (older sister), 弟弟/妹妹 (younger). Age-ranked! 的 = 's: 我的妈妈 (my mum), 他的爸爸 (his dad)!

grammar.title: 的 possession + sibling ranks
grammar.explain: 我的书 (my book), 他的妈妈 (his mum). Siblings: 哥哥/弟弟 (older/younger brother), 姐姐/妹妹 (older/younger sister) — age matters!
grammar.pattern: X + 的 + thing · 哥哥/弟弟

lessons.title: Plan for changing weather
lessons.learn: Make a conditional plan and distinguish a forecast from a certainty.

grammar.title: conditional plan
grammar.explain: Use 如果 to introduce a condition and 就 for the planned result. A forecast remains uncertain.

examples.t: 如果下午下雨，我们就改在室内见。
examples.r: rú guǒ xià wǔ xià yǔ，wǒ men jiù gǎi zài shì nèi jiàn。
examples.en: If it rains this afternoon, we will meet indoors instead.

examples.r: yù bào shuō kě néng yǒu dà fēng。
examples.en: The forecast says there may be strong winds.

examples.t: 出门前带上雨伞比较稳妥。
examples.r: chū mén qián dài shàng yǔ sǎn bǐ jiào wěn tuǒ。
examples.en: It is safer to bring an umbrella before going out.

lessons.title: Opinions: 我觉得 + 比
lessons.learn: Opine! 我觉得… (I feel that…): 我觉得地铁很好! Compare with 比: 北京比上海大 (Beijing is bigger than Shanghai). 更 (even more), 最 (most): 最好 = best!

grammar.title: 我觉得… + A比B + adj
grammar.explain: 我觉得地铁很好 (I think the subway is good). 北京比上海大 (Beijing is bigger than Shanghai). 更大 (even bigger), 最好 (best)!
grammar.pattern: 觉得… · A 比 B + adj · 更/最

culture.text: Chinese speakers use different regional varieties and accents; Standard Mandarin is one shared learning target, not a claim that other varieties are incorrect. In conversation, a speaker may rephrase a word or write it down when listeners use different regional vocabulary.

reading.text: 调查小组先听居民的意见，再看用水数据。两个社区的情况不完全一样。负责人建议增加一次测量，然后再讨论供水方案。
reading.gloss: The survey team first listened to residents' views and then reviewed water-use data. The two communities were not in exactly the same situation. The coordinator suggested taking one more measurement before discussing the supply plan.

listening.script:
组员：这组数据能代表两个社区吗？
负责人：现在还不能，样本比较小。
组员：那我们先把结论写成暂定意见。
负责人：好，再补一次测量。
listening.gloss: Team member: Can these data represent both communities? Coordinator: Not yet; the sample is rather small. Team member: Then let's label the finding provisional. Coordinator: Good, and add another measurement.
